messages:
marta: Heads-up — canaries started throwing kernel errors with llama2-q (q4_0) on runtime 2.8. Saw OOM/unsupported-kernel on step 1. Repro on canary cluster. :eyes:
kevin: Got a link to the logs? if it's a kernel selection change we should pin runtime for production until we have a fix.
marta: Paste of the short trace from canary:
```
RuntimeError: no compatible kernel for q4_0_matmul at attention.cpp:142
stack: runtime/kernel_dispatch -> attention_loop -> matmul
```
sam: Looks like the new dispatcher in 2.8 prefers fused kernels that aren't implemented for q4_0 quant tables. Two options: (1) pin runtime at 2.7.x for affected routes/models, (2) force-model-variant to non-quantized for now. Pin is lower-risk.
rachel: Customer impact? Any paid Dedicated tenants affected?
marta: A couple small Dedicated pools use llama2-q for embeddings in eu-west. We'll need to coordinate with account owners but can limit the pin to those routes. I propose: pin routing to runtime 2.7.11 for all llama2-q model variants in prod until we ship a runtime patch.
sam: +1. Also recommend a canary policy: 10% canary -> monitor 30m -> 50% -> 100% unpin only after patch verified. Rollback criteria: >2% error rate or token latency regression >25% for 15m.
kevin: I'll draft the runtime pin change. Deploy-bot, can you schedule a config change in the 11:00-11:30 UTC change window? We want minimal overlap with other infra jobs.
deploy-bot: Scheduled change: apply routing pin runtime_version=2.7.11 to routes matching "*llama2-q*" on 1782468400 (11:00 UTC). Canary 10% for 30m. Will post progress updates here.
marta: I'll notify the Dedicated account owners and add a release-note stub: "Runtime 2.8 changes kernel selection; pinned certain q4_0 quantized model routes to 2.7.x until runtime patch is released."
kevin: Also add a compatibility note for SDK users: if you rely on q4_0 quantized kernels, pinned runtimes may be returned from routing; add guidance to set model config or upgrade quantization format once runtime 2.8 patch lands.
ops-bot: SLA check: applying pin may increase per-token cost for pinned routes (fallback to non-optimized path). If cost delta > 20% for >4h, open ops-alert.
rachel: Good call. Add owner for release notes and customer comms. Marta, can you own comms?
marta: Yep, I'll draft the customer message and update the release notes page. Target: unpin/patch deploy Tuesday 09:00 PT. For now applying canary pin to prod 10% now as planned. :thumbsup:
